blocks.text: Special liquid crystal devices can be used to diagnose the tumors and infections in the human body. This is because often physical problems, such as tumors, have a different temperature than the surrounding tissue. When cholesteric liquid crystals are applied to the breast, a tumor is located because of being warmer than the other parts. This technique is successfully applied to diagnose breast cancer in the early stage.
